clinician_items: 41010525: the pooled weight result lists Abou-Khalil 2024 (38966098), retracted per 41789013; the review doesn't mention a retraction and that trial isn't in the passage naming high risk-of-bias trials.

39238884: case report, acute pancreatitis in an 84-year-old possibly linked to a weight-loss supplement containing ACV. One case, causality not established.
23373303: case report, erosive tooth wear in a 15-year-old from a daily glass of liquid ACV.
